name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots
description: Dev-time functional stand-in for @mstar-harness/dsh. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed type seats (SlotMap / LocaleNamespaceMap / standard-props kits / ComposedProps machinery) and a minimal SlotCore with the load-time registration contract the mstar panel depends on (undeclared target throws; list id/order/label; children declaration). Mirrors dsh-private commit 9451be2 (2026-08-07 snapshot).
